lead.text: Fixing a wrong answer in the cloud costs about USD 0.02 (mean USD 0.0227, median USD 0.0169 per task, cache-priced); the cost is that on Ollama the failure is silent.
lead.label: measured
lead.note: Every wrong task of the qwen3:14b task run (197) re-run on claude-sonnet-5-5 with the full history and up to 2048 output tokens per call (the local run had 384): fixed 167/197 (84.8%, 95% Wilson CI 79.1% to 89.1%); of the 30 still wrong, 28 inherited the local model's earlier executed actions (the cloud also undid them, which the grader counts as wrong) and 2 are cloud model errors; mean 6.54 s per task.
